versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.1

- Added detailed MARKETING.md guide for users.
- Introduced example Nevada business bankruptcy law firm marketing output.
- Added prompt module files for Digital Advertising Suite, Website Content & Schema, and Reputation & Referral Program.
- Initial package.json file included for deployment and usage clarification.
- No changes to core SKILL.md content; focus on supporting documentation and modular prompt structure.

Nevada Business Bankruptcy Law Marketing Kit v1.0 — Initial Release

- Launches a Nevada-specific marketing kit focused on business bankruptcy law, targeting Chapter 11, Subchapter V, and business Chapter 7 attorneys.
- Includes 4 modules: client acquisition campaigns, digital ad suite, website content & schema, and a reputation/referral program.
- All outputs rigorously checked against 7 detailed Nevada compliance requirements frequently missed by generic AI tools.
- Provides attorney-specific assets: ad copy, website content, intake emails, review templates, Q&As, and compliant referral frameworks.
- Emphasizes clarity on Subchapter V eligibility, preference action pitfalls, and precise disclosures to avoid bar and federal violations.
